_comment: Strings DeepL must not touch, with the reason it cannot be trusted with them.
deepl-xcloc-translate.mjs skips these and reports, per language, which are
still missing a translation — so nothing is silently left in English.
The line is not length: 'Camera' and 'Paste' are one word and come back
right everywhere, because they mean one thing here. What breaks is a word
that is also a brand, a material, or a document. Add a key when a machine
cannot know which sense you meant, and say why.

keys.roundness.rounded: Read as a circulated document: Rundschreiben, 回覧, 通告.
keys.roundness.circular: Same — 'circular' the noun beats 'circular' the shape.
keys.duplicate.library: Must borrow the platform's own term (Photothèque), not a synonym for gallery.
keys.app.name: Brand name. Never translated, never transliterated.
keys.eye.style.leaf: A petal-shaped finder pattern, not foliage and not a page.
keys.eye.style.dot: The shape of a marker, not punctuation.
keys.style.solid: A flat colour, not solid matter — Feststoff, 固体, ठोस.
keys.roundness.sharp: Corner geometry. Read as the Sharp brand (夏普, シャープ) or as spicy.
keys.dataType.icalendar: A calendar entry, as Apple Calendar names it (Ereignis, 日程, इवेंट) — not a public happening: Veranstaltung, 活动.
keys.summary.event.dateOnly: Same word as dataType.icalendar; it must match it.
keys.event.title.placeholder: The name of an appointment. Read alone it becomes a legal or academic title.
keys.event.starts: Calendar vocabulary (Début, Beginn, 開始) — read alone it is a verb and comes back conjugated.
keys.event.allDay: Apple Calendar's own switch label (Journée entière, Ganztägig, 終日), not a paraphrase.
keys.event.location.placeholder: Where an appointment is (Lieu, Ort), not GPS coordinates: Emplacement, Standort.
keys.event.suggestion.accept: Must use the same word for event as dataType.icalendar (创建日程, not 创建活动).
keys.dataType.vcard: A card in the address book (連絡先, جهة اتصال, 联系人) — DeepL gave the website's “contact us”: お問い合わせ, اتصل بنا.
keys.wifi.security.none: Qualifies “security”, feminine in French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Aucune, Ninguna) — alone it comes back masculine.
keys.wifi.hidden: iOS Settings' own term (Réseau masqué, 非公開ネットワーク) — “hidden” alone reads as concealed or secret.
keys.contact.jobTitle.placeholder: A position in a company (Poste, 役職) — read as a title of nobility or of a book.
keys.contact.name.placeholder: A person's full name (姓名, not 名称, the name of a thing).
keys.contact.address.placeholder: A postal address. In Arabic العنوان alone also means title, which event.title.placeholder uses.
keys.contact.company.placeholder: The employer (Entreprise, Firma) — “company” alone comes back as companionship or a military unit.
keys.place.hint: Maps is Apple's app and takes its localized name (Plans, Karten, Mappe, マップ), not the common noun “maps”/“cartes”.
keys.place.suggestion.accept: Same: the app's name (lien Plans, Karten-Link), not “a map link”.
keys.place.title: A place someone goes to (Lieu, Ort, 場所) — alone “Place” comes back as a town square (Place, Platz, Plaza) or the verb.
